messages:
maya: heads-up — rolling the billing-event pipeline canary in prod at 11:30 PT. goal: validate header propagation + dedupe behavior for low-volume tenants.
ajay: thanks. what's the canary scope? single shard or topic partition?
maya: single partition in eu-west-1, ingest -> enrich -> ledger consumer. partition key = tenant_id%32. will tag canary tenants with routing_tag=canary_v2.
sam: are we doing full token-level events or summarized counts for the canary? summarized is lower qps.
maya: full token events. we want to exercise tokenization differences and the kv-eviction edge case.
leo: note: full token events will flip quantization counts — make sure the reconcile job has the filter for routing_tag. otherwise invoice_preview will include them.
irene: ops-bot can you create a temporary dashboard card for canary_v2 events (ingest rate, enrich latency, dedupe rate, duplicate-event pct)?
ops-bot: created dashboard: https://console.internal.redwood/d/evp_canary — panel ids 14,17,22,31. alert rule "canary-dup-pct" at 2% firing threshold.
billing-eng: please add a column for "billing_class" in the event enrichment; we need to ensure billing_class mapping (free/prod/overage) matches the ledger transform. Past mismatch caused wrong prorate.
maya: good catch. current enrich lambda uses plan_id -> billing_class map v1. I'll bump to v2 which matches ledger.
ajay: small concern: enrich v2 depends on the new pricing-service endpoint. Is that behind a feature flag? if pricing-service is down, we should fallback to cached mapping to avoid blocking pipeline.
maya: yes fallback to local cache for 1 hour TTL. fallback code: ```python
try:
  cls = pricing.lookup(plan_id)
except Exception:
  cls = cache.get(plan_id, 'unknown')
```
sam: how are we going to detect silent drift? we need telemetry that compares enrichment.billing_class vs ledger.applied_class and emits a discrepancy event.
leo: can add a enrichment->validator stream that emits a small sample (1%) of events with both classes attached for offline diff.
irene: UX ask: the invoice preview page should highlight canary tenants and show a toggle to exclude them from month-end invoices. ops folks will want that.
billing-eng: toggle = "exclude_canary" on tenant config; must be respected by invoice generator. add acceptance tests.
ajay: related infra note — dedupe window currently 90s. if we change partitioning keys for canary we might create duplicates across partitions for the same session. we should extend dedupe window to 5m for canary shard during rollout.
maya: done in canary deploy config: dedupe_window_ms=300000. monitor dedupe inflow.
ops-bot: alert created: canary-dedupe-spike if dup events > 0.5% for 5m.
leo: one more: header propagation for request-id was being dropped by the ingress sidecar when Content-Type changed to application/grpc. Added patch to preserve x-rw-request-id across proxies.
sam: thanks — that was the silent failure that broke our traceability last week. any test we can run pre-rollout?
maya: run this locally: ```bash
# simulate grpc-ingest header pass-through
echo '{"tenant_id":"t-canary","tokens":42}' | \
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/grpc' -H 'x-rw-request-id: test-123' \
  http://localhost:8080/ingest?routing_tag=canary_v2 -d @- 
```
and then check kafka message headers: ```bash
kafka-console-consumer --property print.headers=true --from-beginning --topic billing-events | grep test-123```

irene: timeline? we prefer a 2h canary, then expand to 10% of partitions for 24h if no alerts.
maya: plan: canary start 11:30 PT (partition 7), monitor 2h, expand to 3 partitions (7,8,9) for 24h, then full rollout. rollback if dup pct > 0.5 or enrichment mismatch rate > 0.2%.
billing-eng: add automated canary tag to invoice-preview backfill job to avoid accidental chargebacks.
ajay: quick note for console: when canary is active, per-route cost card should show two columns (canary_v2 vs baseline) and a tooltip explaining sampling. small UX change but helps ops.
leo: logging: add event.trace_id + ingest.kafka_offset in the telemetry payload we emit to datadog (for fast hunt).
sam: okay, I'm going to run the local header test and kick off canary assets. ping me on this thread when you start the 11:30 deploy.
maya: starting canary in 10. (will post status in thread).
[10:20] ops-bot: deployment job evp-canary-v2 started (job id: job-8843). status: queued.
[11:31] maya: canary partition 7 deployed. ingest rate ~9rps, enrich lat 120ms median. no dup alerts yet.
[12:05] sam: saw 0.12% dup rate in last 30m, validate dedupe consumer offset handling looks ok.
[12:20] leo: enrichment mismatch sample shows 4 mismatches out of 500 sampled (0.8%) — investigating mapping fallback.
maya: rolling back enrichment to v1 mapping for canary partition 7 while we fix the pricing-service edge case. pausing expansion.
irene: ops: please mark canary tenants as excluded from invoice previews until mapping is fixed.
ops-bot: tenant tags updated: exclude_canary=true for 12 tenants.
billing-eng: opened issue ENG-BILL-421 with repro and sample messages. assign to ajay.
ajay: on it — will add better cache warming and a circuit-breaker to avoid 'unknown' billing_class.
maya: thanks team. will re-run canary after fix. postmortem-ish note: we should add a preflight that compares enrichment.billing_class vs cached lookup before full traffic.
sam: +1 — and add a tiny canary harness that replays 1k synthetic events through the entire pipeline in staging nightly.
maya: noted. closing this thread for now; will reopen when we attempt the next canary.
[12:45] ops-bot: job job-8843 completed: rolled back.
